name: PW Scale MAC Mobility + HA -- 200 PE-4 <-> RR-SA-2 PWs
source: natural-language:/TEST PW scale 200 services + SW-204115 HA

scale.doc: Number of matched PE-4/RR-SA-2 PW services. Use scale=10 for smoke.

service_offset.doc: Global service index starts at 1 + service_offset. Default inner VLAN window is 3101..3300; offset 200 uses 3301..3500.

ha_mode.doc: core3 = NCC switchover + routing:bgpd restart + wb_agent/NCP datapath restart.

dnaas_preflight_mode.doc: full checks every PE-4 and RR-SA-2 stream recipe before config and again after config; sample checks chunk boundaries for smoke/debug only.

dnaas_parallelism.doc: Parallel dnos_dnaas_spirent_preflight calls for the 2 * scale window.

topology_anchor.description: 200 matched EVPN-SI VPLS services between PE-4 and RR-SA-2. PE-4 traffic rides DNAAS fab 213 and user outer 219. RR-SA-2 traffic rides DNAAS fab 215 and B-15 rewrites user outer 215 to DUT wire outer 4 while preserving valid 802.1Q inner tags.

service_index_rule.inner_vlan: 3100 + global_index; default run uses 3101..3300 and must stay within 1..4094

non_overlap_contract.label_block_note: label-block-size is the per-instance width, so it remains 8. The non-overlap key is the per-service site-id plus label_block_ordinal/budget metadata; DNOS owns the actual dynamic label allocation.

rr_sa_2.spirent_frame: Q-in-Q outer=215 inner=<inner_vlan>; B-15 rewrites outer to 4

proof_contract: Every PE4 entry uses --vlan 219 --inner-vlan <inner_vlan> and expects L> on PE-4, v> on RR-SA-2.
Every RR entry uses --vlan 215 --inner-vlan <inner_vlan> and expects L> on RR-SA-2, v> on PE-4.
Every stream uses a deterministic unknown-unicast destination MAC (02:aa:ad:01:* for PE-4-side, 02:aa:be:01:* for RR-side), never broadcast.

prerequisites.expect: all service names, inner VLANs, EVIs, RTs, RDs, ACs, site IDs, label-block ordinals, stream names, ownership tags, and MACs are unique; all inner VLANs are within 1..4094
no generated EVPN_PW_S service name and no generated PE-4/RR-SA-2 AC name already exists before bulk creation

prerequisites.fix: This recipe bumps the soft warning cap to 500. It is not a Spirent hardware limit.

prerequisites.expect: bgp-vpls In use label total is >= scale * label-block-size and matches the configured bgp-vpls label pool after restart
prerequisites.fail_when: Configured bgp-vpls pool is large enough but In use remains smaller, or DNOS prints 'Configured values differ from current in use values, restart system to apply new values.'
prerequisites.remediation: Keep routing-options bgp-vpls-label-block-size >= scale * label-block-size, perform full cold 'request system restart' on the affected cluster, then re-run show mpls label-allocation tables and require bgp-vpls In use to match the configured pool. bgpd/container/NCC restarts and switchover are not accepted fixes for this gate.

pass_criteria: standby NCC is standby-up for switchover tests

show_commands_validated.show system | no-more: HA readiness, active/standby NCC, failover budget.
show_commands_validated.show config | flatten: Documented DNOS syntax. Live collision guard before creating generated EVPN_PW_S services and ACs.
show_commands_validated.show system alarms | no-more: Abort on critical alarms before HA. Live-validated on PE-4 and RR-SA-2, DNOS 19.2.13.x lab image, 2026-05-03.
show_commands_validated.show interfaces management | no-more: NCE IP mapping for cluster HA.
show_commands_validated.show mpls label-allocation tables | no-m: Label pool integrity and SW-253359 gate.
show_commands_validated.show config routing-options | no-more: bgp-vpls-label-block-size discovery. Live-validated on PE-4 and RR-SA-2, DNOS 19.2.13.x lab image, 2026-05-03.
show_commands_validated.show network-services evpn all | no-more: Bulk visibility check for generated EVPN service names.
show_commands_validated.show network-services evpn {service_name: Per-service EVI, interface, and remote PE state.
show_commands_validated.show evpn vpls-pw | no-more: PW establishment count after bulk config. Live-validated on PE-4 and RR-SA-2, DNOS 19.2.13.x lab image, 2026-05-03.
show_commands_validated.show evpn instance {service_name} detail: Per-service EVI, AC, BGP-VPLS neighbor, and VPLS PW state. Live-validated with EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 on PE-4 and RR-SA-2, 2026-05-03.
show_commands_validated.show evpn instance {service_name} vpls-p: Per-service PW status. Live-validated with EVPN_SI_VPLS_1 on PE-4 and RR-SA-2, 2026-05-03.
show_commands_validated.show evpn mac-table detail instance {ser: Detailed flags when a service fails the fast MAC check.
show_commands_validated.show bgp l2vpn vpls summary | no-more: VPLS BGP session state. Live-validated on PE-4 and RR-SA-2, DNOS 19.2.13.x lab image, 2026-05-03.
show_commands_validated.show system process wb_agent | no-more: NCP datapath agent health after HA.

invalid_commands.show evpn mac-table instance {service_na: Wrong DNOS order. Use 'show evpn mac-table detail instance {service_name}'.
invalid_commands.show interfaces brief: Does not exist in DNOS. Use 'show interfaces description'.
invalid_commands.show bgp ipv4 flowspec-vpn summary: Does not exist. Use 'show bgp ipv4 flowspec summary' for FlowSpec tests.

phases.name: bulk_config_setup
phases.python_justification: Chunked multi-device commits with conditional stop on first failure.

phases.name: verify_dnaas_ready_after_config
phases.pass_when: every checked PE-4/RR-SA-2 preflight verdict is READY after ACs are committed
phases.python_justification: Parallel post-config DNAAS preflight across 2 * scale StreamBlock recipes before creating live Spirent traffic.

phases.name: ha_bgpd_restart
phases.ha_command_template: request system process restart ncc {active_ncc_id} routing-engine routing:bgpd

phases.name: ha_wb_agent_restart
phases.ha_command_template: request system container restart ncp {active_ncp_id} datapath

thresholds.mac_learning_required: 2 * scale source MACs, each visible local on origin and v> on peer

scale_gates: PW count: 200/200 visible on both DUTs
MAC source isolation: no local flag on the peer for a remote PW-learned MAC
Stream loss histogram preserved per StreamBlock
During every HA event, Spirent aggregate and per-stream loss counters must not increase
SW-253359 label-pool signature absent before and after HA

cleanup_policy.spirent_cleanup: remove streams whose names start pw_scale_pe4_ or pw_scale_rr_
